Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:1.hebrew: וללישנא בתרא דרב כהנא - דאמר טמאין אין עושין לא זה ולא זה, הא דקתני טמאים נדחין לשני, היכי מתרצא לה:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:1.english: And according to the latter version of Rav Kahana - Who said [that] impure [people] perform neither this [first Pesach] nor that [second Pesach]: that which was taught [that] impure [people] are deferred to the second [Pesach], how is it reconciled?

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:2.hebrew: משלימות לטמאין - דבזכרים הוו טהורים רובא, אבל יש מן הנשים טמאות יותר מן הטהורות עד שמשלימות החשבון למחצה על מחצה. וקסבר האי תנא: נשים בראשון רשות, וכ"ש בשני; הילכך, דל נשים מהכא, דאינן מן המניין, וזיל בתר זכרים, והוו טמאים מיעוטא ומדחו לשני. אבל בפלגא ופלגא — אי כמר אי כמר:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:2.english: [Women] complete [the number of] the impure - For among the men, the pure are the majority, but there are more impure women than pure [women], such that they complete the count to half and half. And this Tanna holds [that] women [are] optional on the first [Pesach], and all the more so on the second; therefore, remove [the] women from here, for they are not part of the count, and follow the men, and [thus] the impure are a minority and are deferred to the second [Pesach]. However, in [a case of] half and half — [it is] either like this master or like that master.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:3.hebrew: כגון שהיו ישראל - הזכרים מחצה טהורין ומחצה טמאין, וכשאתה מונה הנשים עמהן, רבין טהורים על הטמאים:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:11:3.english: Where Israel were - The males [were] half pure and half impure, and when you count the women with them, the pure outnumber the impure.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:14:1.hebrew: בראשון חובה - והרי הן במנין, ונמצאו טמאים מיעוטא:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:14:1.english: In the first [Pesach], [it is] obligatory - And behold, they [the women] are in the count, and [thus] the impure are found to be a minority.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:14:2.hebrew: ובשני נשים רשות - ותנאי פליגי בהא מילתא בפ' האשה (לקמן פסחים דף צא:):
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:14:2.english: And in the second [Pesach], women [are] optional - And Tannaim disagree regarding this matter in the chapter [entitled] HaIsha (later, Pesachim 91b).

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:15:1.english: On the first [Pesach] they do not perform [it] - [Meaning] those who are impure, since they are a minority.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:15:2.hebrew: ובשני לא עבדי - דלגבי שני אין הנשים מן המנין למיהוי טהורין רובא. הילכך, לא הוו טמאים מיעוטא אלא פלגא, ולרב מחצה על מחצה כרוב, ולא עבדי בשני:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:15:2.english: And on the second [Pesach] they do not perform [it] - For regarding the second [Pesach], women are not included in the count for the pure [people] to be the majority; therefore, the impure [people] are not a minority, rather half, and according to Rav, half and half is [treated] like a majority, so they do not perform [it] on the second [Pesach].

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:16:1.hebrew: ורב כהנא - דאמר פלגא עבדי בשני, מתרץ הכי כו':
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:16:1.english: And Rav Kahana - who said [that] half perform [the Paschal offering] on the second [Pesach], resolves [it] thus, etc.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:16:2.hebrew: ונשים משלימות לטהורין - שלא היו טהורין מחצה אלא על ידי הנשים, ואי אזלינן בתר זכרים, הוו טמאין רובא. ועודפות עליהן לא גרסינן:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:16:2.english: And women complete [the number of] the pure - For the pure were not half except through the women, and if we follow the males, the impure were the majority. We do not read "and exceed them."

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:17:1.english: And half on the first [Pesach] do not perform [it] - in [a state of] impurity, according to the first version of Rav Kahana.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:18:1.hebrew: תנאי היא - האי תנא ותנא דלעיל דקאי כוותיה. האי תנא סבר מחצה על מחצה הוי כרוב, ותנא דלעיל סבר אינו כרוב:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:18:1.english: It is [a dispute of] tanna’im - [Between] this tanna and the tanna [cited] above who holds like him [Rav Kahana]. This tanna holds [that] half and half is like a majority, and the tanna above holds [that] it is not like a majority.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:19:1.english: They perform [it] in impurity - Even those who are pure.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:1:1.hebrew: וטמאין אין עושין לא את הראשון - דכיון דאינו כרוב, לא עבדי בטומאה, ובשני נמי לא, דאינו מיעוט:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:1:1.english: And those who are impure do not perform [the ritual on] the first - For since it is not like a majority, they do not perform [it] in [a state of] impurity; and on the second [Pesach] as well [they do] not, for it is not a minority.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:2:1.english: They shall perform [it] in impurity - Even the pure ones.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:2:2.hebrew: רובא הוא כו' - כי איטמי רובא, הוא דעבדי טמאין ראשון ובטומאה:
Rashi on Pesachim 79b:2:2.english: It is [only when] most of it [is impure], etc. - When the majority became impure, [only then] do the impure ones perform the first [Pesach], and [they do so] in impurity.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:2:3.english: But [if it is] half and half, they do not perform [it] - [The] impure ones [do not perform it] on the first [Pesach] at all.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:3:1.english: All of them - Even those who are pure do not need to be careful about guarding [their] purity.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:4:1.english: It is reasonable - that [when it is] half and half as well, the impure ones perform [the offering] in [a state of] impurity and are not deferred.

Rashi on Pesachim 79b:5:1.english: To Rav - Who said [that] these [offer] by themselves and those [offer] by themselves.

Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:12:1.hebrew: קסבר נשים בראשון רשות - משום רב איצטריך למימר הכי, דאי בראשון חובה הוה אמרינן דהללו עושין לעצמן כו'. אבל לרב כהנא, אפילו הוו בראשון חובה אתי שפיר, דפלגא בראשון לא עבדי ובשני עבדי; כיון דבשני נשים רשות, הוו להו טמאים מיעוטא. והא דאמר בפר' קמא דסנהדרין (דף יב.) גבי חזקיהו שהשיא את ישראל לעשות פסח שני: "היכי דמי? אמר רב אשי: כגון שהיו ישראל מחצה טמאים ומחצה טהורין, ונשים משלימות לטהורים ועודפות עליהן; מעיקרא סבר נשים בראשון חובה, והוו להו טמאים מיעוטא ומידחו לפסח שני, ולבסוף סבר נשים בראשון רשות, והוו להו טמאים רובא, ורובא בשני לא עבדי". והשתא לרב וללישנא בתרא דרב כהנא לא הוה צריך למינקט "משלימות", אלא "עודפות עליהן" גרידא; וללישנא קמא דרב כהנא הוה מצי למינקט "משלימות" ולא "עודפות", אלא נקט "משלימות ועודפות" דהשתא לכולהו לישני עשה שלא כתורה. והוה מצי לשנויי דלבסוף סבר נשים בראשון חובה ובשני רשות, ולכך לאו שפיר עבד פסח שני; אלא משום דהתם אליבא דרבי שמעון קיימינן, דאית ליה לקמן בפרק האשה (פסחים דף צא:) נשים בראשון רשות. אי נמי, ניחא ליה למידחי דאף מה שלא עשו בראשון היה שלא כדין:
Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:12:1.english: He holds [that] women in the first [Pesaḥ] are optional - It was necessary to say this on account of Rav, for if [women] in the first [Pesaḥ] were obligatory, we would say that these [pure people] perform [the offering] for themselves, etc. However, according to Rav Kahana, even if [women] were obligatory in the first [Pesaḥ], it works out well, for half [and half] do not perform [the offering] in the first [Pesaḥ] and do perform [it] in the second [Pesaḥ]; since in the second [Pesaḥ] women are optional, the impure are a minority. And [regarding] that which [the Gemara] says in the first chapter of Sanhedrin (12a) concerning Hezekiah, who persuaded Israel to observe the second Pesaḥ: "What were the circumstances? Rav Ashi said: For example, where Israel was half impure and half pure, and the women complete the pure and exceed them; initially he held [that] women in the first [Pesaḥ] are obligatory, so the impure were a minority and are deferred to the second Pesaḥ, and ultimately he held [that] women in the first [Pesaḥ] are optional, so the impure were a majority, and a majority does not perform [the offering] in the second [Pesaḥ]." And now, according to Rav and according to the latter version of Rav Kahana, it was not necessary to state "complete," rather "exceed them" alone; and according to the first version of Rav Kahana, he could have stated "complete" and not "exceed," rather he stated "complete and exceed" so that now, according to all versions, he acted not in accordance with the Torah. And [the Gemara] could have answered that ultimately he held [that] women in the first [Pesaḥ] are obligatory and in the second [Pesaḥ] are optional, and therefore he did not act properly [in having them observe] the second Pesaḥ; rather, [it did not answer this] because there we are standing according to Rabbi Shimon, who holds below in the chapter HaIshah (Pesachim 91b) [that] women in the first [Pesaḥ] are optional. Alternatively, it was preferable to him to reject [Hezekiah's action by explaining] that even their not performing [the offering] in the first [Pesaḥ] was not in accordance with the law.

Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:12:2.hebrew: נשים בראשון רשות - הוה מצי למינקט בברייתא רוב טהורים וע"י נשים היו רוב טמאים — נדחין לפסח שני, כיון דנשים בראשון רשות והוו להו מיעוט טמאים:
Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:12:2.english: [The participation of] women in the first [Pesach] is optional - [The Gemara] could have taken [a case] in the baraita [where there was] a majority of pure [men], and through women they became a majority of impure [people] — [even so,] they are deferred to the second Pesach, since [the participation of] women in the first [Pesach] is optional, and [thus, excluding them,] they are a minority of impure [people].

Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:14:1.hebrew: ורב כהנא מתרץ לה הכי כו' - השתא נמי הוה מצי למינקט בברייתא רבותא, דאפי' רוב טהורין אין הטמאין עושין את השני, כיון שבלא נשים הוו טהורים מיעוטא; ומצינו למימר דנקט בכי האי גוונא, לאשמועי' דמחצה על מחצ' אינו כרוב:
Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:14:1.english: And Rav Kahana reconciles it thus, etc. - Even now [according to Rav Kahana], he could have presented a more novel case in the baraita, that even [when there is] a majority of pure [people], the impure do not perform the second [Pesaḥ], since without the women the pure [men] are a minority; however, we can say that he chose [to explain it] in this manner to teach us that half-and-half is not [treated] like a majority.

Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:1:1.hebrew: וטמאין אין עושין לא את הראשון ולא את השני - קשה לריב"א: אי פלגא מיקרו "איש", לידחו לפסח שני; ואי לא מיקרו "איש" אלא ציבור, ליעביד בטומאה בראשון! וליכא למימר דמספקא ליה אי חשיבי איש או ציבור, דאם כן ליטמאו אחד מן הטהורים. דבשלמא אי לא מספקא ליה, אתי שפיר — דלמה יטמאו את הטהור לעשות בטומאה, כיון שדין של טמאין ליפטר לגמרי. ואומר ר"י דלא מיקרו "איש", ומ"מ לא יעשו הטהורים בטומאה בשבילם, כיון שאין רוב טמאים; ואין עושין נמי אלו לעצמן ואלו לעצמן, דקסבר אין קרבן ציבור חלוק. אע"ג דלר' יהודה — דאית ליה לקמן אין קרבן ציבור חלוק — קאמר יעשו כולם בטומאה, רב כהנא לית ליה הך סברא, אלא קסבר דמהאי טעמא נידחין לגמרי:
Tosafot on Pesachim 79b:1:1.english: And those who are impure do not perform [the ritual of the Paschal lamb on] the first [Pesaḥ] or the second - The Riva [Rabbi Yitzḥak ben Asher] raises a difficulty: If half [of the community] are called "an individual," let them be deferred to the second Pesaḥ; and if they are not called "an individual" but rather a congregation, let [the sacrifice] be performed in impurity on the first [Pesaḥ]! And one cannot say that [Rav Kahana] is in doubt whether they are considered an individual or a congregation, for if so, let them render one of the pure people impure [to create an impure majority]. For granted, if he is not in doubt, it works out well — since why should they render a pure person impure to perform [the sacrifice] in impurity, given that the law of the impure ones is to be completely exempt? And the Ri [Rabbi Yitzḥak] says that they are not called "an individual," and nevertheless the pure ones do not perform [the sacrifice] in impurity on their behalf, since there is not a majority of impure people; nor do these perform [it] by themselves and those by themselves, because he holds that a communal offering is not divided. Even though according to Rabbi Yehudah — who holds later on that a communal offering is not divided — he says "all of them shall perform [it] in impurity," Rav Kahana does not hold that reasoning, but rather holds that for this reason they are completely deferred.
